post.originalText:
OPUS 5.5 WHAT THE ACTUAL FUCK 😭🔥
I asked it to bring Attack on Titan gear into Minecraft, and now I’m flying through a forest at sunset with dual blades and grappling hooks attached to pine trees
No Titans. No enemies. Just me swinging between trees like I’m in the actual anime 💀
And somehow, the empty forest makes the whole thing feel even more cinematic
Now imagine adding 15-meter Titans that emerge between the trees while you’re flying toward your next grapple point
Or making the trees collapse when you hook onto them, turning the entire forest into a survival nightmare
I WAS ASKING FOR A MOD. OPUS IS OUT HERE BUILDING AN ENTIRE GAME. 🤯
